memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in ADLs, works as software engineer, reports no difficulty climbing stairs or walking to office.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal).
falls: No falls in past 12 months; gait normal; timed up-and-go 8 seconds (within normal limits).
medicines: 0 regular.
mood: Reports low mood, anhedonia, PHQ-9 to be checked.
carers: Mother, Mrs. Rao, provides emotional support.
goals: "I want to feel better and keep up with my work."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
PHQ-9: 14 (moderate depression).
TSH: 2.1 mIU/L (ref 0.4-4.0).
Vitamin B12: 210 pg/mL (ref 200-900).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
sertraline 50 mg OD
escitalopram 10 mg OD
mirtazapine 15 HS
salbutamol MDI SOS
budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD
montelukast 10 mg HS

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Using salbutamol inhaler 3-4 times daily for wheeze; feels chest tight after long coding sessions. Mood low, still needing extra effort to get out of bed.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Able to work full days but notes occasional shortness of breath on exertion; uses salbutamol before stairs.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5.
falls: No falls; gait steady; timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 6 regular (sertraline, escitalopram, mirtazapine, salbutamol SOS, budesonide-formoterol BD, montelukast).
mood: PHQ-9 13, reports persistent low mood.
carers: Mother, Mrs. Rao, helps with medication reminders.
goals: "I want to breathe easier and enjoy my weekends."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (80% predicted), FVC 3.6 L (85%); post-bronchodilator FEV1 3.2 L (92%) – positive reversibility.
Asthma Control Test: 18/25 (partly controlled).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Increase budesonide-formoterol to 200/6 inhaler BID
Add tiotropium inhaler 2 puffs OD
Continue salbutamol SOS
Continue antidepressants unchanged

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports improved exercise tolerance; can jog 2 km without wheeze; still occasional mild dyspnea on stairs.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (annual screen due).
falls: No falls in past year; gait normal; timed up-and-go 8 seconds.
medicines: 7 regular (sertraline, escitalopram, mirtazapine, salbutamol SOS, budesonide-formoterol BID, tiotropium OD, montelukast).
mood: PHQ-9 9 (mild depression).
carers: Mother, Mrs. Rao, encourages exercise.
goals: "I want to stop using the rescue inhaler daily."

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
PHQ-9: 9
TSH: 2.3 mIU/L
Vitamin B12: 225 pg/mL

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Stop tiotropium (no added benefit)
Reduce budesonide-formoterol to 200/6 inhaler BD
Continue salbutamol SOS
Continue antidepressants unchanged
Add vitamin D3 1000 IU OD (low sunlight exposure)

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Feeling drowsy in mornings since starting vitamin D; also notice increased appetite and weight gain of 2 kg over past month. Mood stable, but worried about daytime sleepiness affecting work.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Able to concentrate at work but notes morning grogginess; uses alarm twice.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5.
falls: No falls; gait normal; timed up-and-go 8 seconds.
medicines: 7 regular (sertraline, escitalopram, mirtazapine, salbutamol SOS, budesonide-formoterol BD, montelukast, vitamin D3).
mood: PHQ-9 8, reports mild anhedonia.
carers: Mother, Mrs. Rao, notes patient sleeps later.
goals: "I want to wake up refreshed and be productive in the mornings."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: ECG: Sinus rhythm 78 bpm, normal axis, no ST-T changes. No evidence of ischemia or hypertrophy.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
Stop vitamin D3
Reduce mirtazapine to 7.5 mg HS
Continue sertraline 50 mg OD
Continue escitalopram 10 mg OD
Continue salbutamol SOS
Continue budesonide-formoterol BD
Continue montelukast HS

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Booked follow-up visit with Dr Nandini Kulkarni for 2026-02-15 at 10:30 AM.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Reports good energy levels; no morning grogginess; works full day without naps.
cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5.
falls: No falls; gait normal; timed up-and-go 8 seconds.
medicines: 6 regular (sertraline, escitalopram, mirtazapine 7.5 mg HS, salbutamol SOS, budesonide-formoterol BD, montelukast).
mood: PHQ-9 6 (mild).
carers: Mother, Mrs. Rao, supportive.
goals: "I want to maintain this balance and keep improving my asthma control."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Pulmonology review: Spirometry shows FEV1 3.0 L (88% predicted) with good reversibility. Asthma well controlled on current regimen. Continue budesonide-formoterol BD and montelukast. No change needed.
